name: Orpah
bio: Orpah is Naomi's Moabite daughter-in-law, married to one of her sons, and sister-in-law to Ruth. When Naomi urges both widowed daughters-in-law to return to their own people and gods rather than follow her back to Bethlehem, Orpah weeps, kisses Naomi goodbye, and turns back — a reasonable, understandable choice. Her decision is not condemned in the text, but it stands in deliberate contrast to Ruth's, highlighting just how extraordinary Ruth's loyalty and faith truly are.
